query:
-- Estoque atual por galão
SELECT id, gallon_number, stock_liters, last_price_per_liter
FROM gallon_stock
ORDER BY gallon_number;

-- Abastecimentos recentes (últimos 10 dias) com colunas corretas
SELECT id, vessel_name, client_name, client_email, liters, liters_calculated, total_amount, gallon_number, asaas_charge_id, payment_status, created_at
FROM fuel_records
WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 DAY)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
